purpose: Global map albedo; terrain-art.md owner implementation request 2026-10-04

generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original production meadow-ground albedo texture for Warwrit's existing 2.5D map, 1024x1024 square, opaque PNG. Supplied images are STYLE AND MATERIAL references only: image1 irregular ink/flat wash style; image2 town material; image3 village straw/earth; image4 river material. Do not reproduce their subjects or perspective. Flat perpendicular overhead surface, edge to edge, no horizon. Quiet desaturated grey-olive and dry ochre short meadow grass in irregular small loose groups, with substantial calm exposed warm grey umber earth between groups. Fine variable broken ink hatching selectively describes short grass and small earth depressions; grouped shadow marks, broad quiet flat earthy washes. Serious grounded dark fantasy, credible material, restrained background contrast subordinate to settlement sprites. Dry straw accents match village vegetation. Medium detail spread evenly, no isolated large landmark or obvious repetition, no photographic grain, no dense bright grass-wire mesh, no fuzzy round tufts, no cute forms, vivid green, glossy PBR, framing or vignette. Nondirectional texture: no painted sun direction, cast shadows, highlights, perspective compression, roads, ruts, streams, ordered rows, trees, buildings, people, symbols, writing or watermarks. Engine blends rotated interior patches, so retain clear selective ink forms without thick outlines everywhere; compatible average color at all edges. One coherent surface only, not a montage. Target average dry muted olive/umber around #7B7151, ink depth around #292822; keep shadow sparse enough that playable night remains readable.

license: original work generated for Warwrit using supplied project-owned style references; no third-party art copied
processing: Original generated raster copied unchanged; requested 1024 square is not the actual dimension.

integration.colorSpace: sRGB albedo, manual linear decode in ShaderMaterial
integration.sampling: Continuously blended rotated interior patches; no mirrors or edge tiling

limits: Opposite-edge continuity not assumed; interior sampling prevents edge seams
No performance or full-game acceptance claimed by this sidecar
